svg.text: T005 — Latin/Korean Script-Fallback Metric & Raster Proof
Measured from actual installed open-source fonts with FreeType light-target rendering. Browser/shaping PASS is not implied.
A. Metric spans and x-height matching factors
pair xh primary/fallback xh scale typo span P/F hhea span P/F
Different table metrics can imply materially different vertical spans. Actual UA line-box choice remains a browser/platform question.
B. Raster body height at nominal 20 ppem
Same nominal em size does not produce the same script body size or baseline relationship.
Exact alpha coverage, top/bottom extents and font hashes are stored in T005-mixed-script-results.json.
C. Method challenge — blind x-height normalization
Disposition: reject Latin x-height matching as a generic Latin→Korean optical-matching rule.
This limits—not rejects—font-size-adjust. Use script-specific evidence before scaling Korean fallback.
D. L002 long-label transfer — controlled 20 ppem advance sum
With the same Inter primary, fallback choice changes this controlled width from 486 to 503 px (~3.5%).
These are unshaped FreeType advance sums, not browser line widths. Significance depends on the actual container and wrap policy.
PRACTICE + CRITIQUE / font-table + FreeType transfer evidence. Reproducible raster specimens are generated by the companion Python source.
OPEN: browser shaping/fallback, CoreText/DirectWrite/Skia/Flutter, CSS metric overrides, real line boxes, Korean line breaking, human judgment, Color viewing conditions.
